HOME HIGHLIGHTS:
- Gulf-front
- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for an additional $30/day fee
- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella (service provided Mar 1-Nov 30)
- Freshly updated
- Wolf Range and Sub-Zero kitchen appliances
- Sunset deck
- Outdoor kitchen
- Natural gas grill
- 6 adult bikes provided
- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkout

DETAILS: Along the quartz sand beaches and turquoise waters of Seacrest Beach, you'll find a 6-bedroom, 5.5-bath Gulf-front getaway like no other. The McAlpine Dutch architecture is simply stunning, while the design is all about comfort. Have your morning coffee on a deck with sweeping Gulf views and enjoy sunsets with loved ones around the private pool. Being Gulf-front, the sugar-soft sand of Emerald Coast is your backyard.

Enter through the gated courtyard to the travertine foyer. Here you'll find a Gulf-front guest bedroom with an en-suite bathroom. Adjoining the bedroom is a media room with a bunk area that sleeps 4 - a favorite of the young and the young at heart - with a shared bathroom just steps away.

The second floor is the life of the home. Ascending by either the staircase or elevator, you'll enter the gourmet kitchen, living room, and balcony - all with stunning Gulf views. The gourmet kitchen features designer cabinets and high-end appliances, including a Sub-Zero double fridge, 2 dishwashers, and a 6-burner Wolf stove with a griddle top. The living area offers comfy designer furniture and an expansive Frame TV, making it the perfect place to enjoy a vacation movie night. The dining area provides seating for 8, with seating for 4 at the island counter. Nano doors open onto a deck with beautifully appointed outdoor furniture and panoramic Gulf views.

The second floor also offers a second living room with an adjoining kitchenette featuring a convection oven and a full-size fridge. Steps away is the laundry room with 2 stacked full-sized washer/dryer sets. Adjacent is a guest bedroom with shared bath, as well as a second bunk room. Just down the stairs, you'll find an additional washer and dryer and a guest bedroom with an en-suite bathroom.
The third floor is simply transcendent. Here you'll find a master bedroom with a Tempur-Pedic king bed, a walk-in closet, an en-suite bathroom with Hansgrohe multi-head shower, and a claw-foot soaker tub precisely positioned to take in an amazing view of the Gulf. The balcony also offers Gulf views spanning from Panama City Beach to Destin - the perfect place to enjoy your morning coffee and an evening cocktail. A gas fire pit lends an intimate atmosphere, while a wet bar just steps away.

Perhaps the loveliest aspects of this professionally decorated home are the many surprises - the tasteful furnishings throughout, as well as the ground-level outdoor wet bar with a Sub-Zero Fridge, BBQ grill, and fire pit. Of course, Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach are just a short bike ride away!

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 16):

FIRST FLOOR:
- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only
- Bonus bunk area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Junior Twin-over Junior Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom, with Shower/Tub Combo

THIRD FLOOR:
- Master Bedroom: King Tempur-Pedic Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate *Please be mindful to not overfill the bathtub. Doing so can cause destructive leakage to the 2nd floor.

FIRST FLOOR ATTACHED CARRIAGE HOUSE:
- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only

SECOND FLOOR ATTACHED CARRIAGE HOUSE:
- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo
- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk beds

Pets are not allowed in this home. Failure to adhere to this rule may result in immediate eviction and loss of deposit. Guests are fully responsible for all damages.
